thread:
elena: Heads-up: we're publishing a tiny migration note for the v1->v2 SDK change and a model id rename (open-llama-v1 -> open-llama-2-compat). Infra will rotate the exact-id alias; pinned ids will return 412 after the flip. We should also publish a small codemod snippet customers can run to sweep configs. Can someone own the codemod + examples?
ryan: I can write a codemod example (node script) and add instructions for bulk-replace in repo configs. Will include a dry-run flag.
sam: I'll update TypeScript examples and add a short API error handler that falls back to the family alias. Example will be tiny, since most users just copy quickstart.
jiwoo: Python snippets + a unit test for the sample-app to catch pinned ids. Also will add a note about SDK versions (v2+ required).
maria: I'll add the migration note page and a short "how to detect if you're affected" checklist (grep for model ids in infra/templates, env vars, and Helm charts). Also adding changelog entry.
docs-bot: Preview will appear after PRs merge; please link PRs here.
ryan: Codemod plan: node script that replaces occurrences of "open-llama-v1" with "open-llama-2-compat" and optionally swaps client.models.predict -> client.responses.create. Sample:
```js
// dry-run: node codemod.js --dry-run
// codemod: replace string literals and common SDK call patterns
```
I'll open PR to add script under /tools/codemods in docs repo.
sam: TS snippet swap: old: `client.models.predict({model: 'open-llama-v1', prompt: '...'})` -> new: `client.responses.create({model: 'open-llama-2-compat', input: '...'})`. Will also add fallback: on 412 switch to `open-llama`.
jiwoo: Python tests: small pytest that loads example config and asserts it doesn't contain deprecated ids. Will add to sample-app CI to catch regressions.
maria: Timeline: merge PRs by Thu 22:00 PT so preview is live. Infra flip Fri 02:00 PT. I'll add a support note for the Customer Success team with FAQ snippets.
elena: Good. Also include an ops suggestion to monitor for traffic spikes and recommend jittered exponential backoff for 429s/503s. Ryan, add an escape hatch in codemod to only change non-production branches by default.
ryan: Will do. Opening PRs now.
docs-bot: PR previews: https://deploy-preview-4401--docs.redwood.ai/migrations/codemod, https://deploy-preview-4402--docs.redwood.ai/examples/snippets
maria: Thanks everyone ":shipit:" — ping me if you need reviews.
